claims.text: Phlebotomy = mainstay; targets Hct < 45% in men, < 42% in women.
claims.quote: Phlebotomy is the mainstay of therapy. The targets for phlebotomy are a hematocrit < 45% in men and < 42% in women

claims.text: RCT: Hct < 45% → sig ↓CV death and thrombosis.
claims.quote: A randomized trial showed that patients randomized to a hematocrit < 45% had a significantly lower rate of cardiovascular death and thrombosis
